description: Discover search competitors for a domain and prioritize overlap, traffic gaps, and next analysis actions. Uses AgentSEO credits; repeating the call can create new charged work.

language.description: Supported search language code, for example en for English. Type: String. Default: "en".

limit.description: Maximum number of competing domain records to return. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 5. Maximum: 250. Default: 25.

location.description: Supported geographic search-market name, for example United States; this is not a coordinate pair. Type: String. Default: "United States".

location_code.description: Numeric provider location identifier for the search market; the service validates support alongside the location name. Type: Safe integer. Must be greater than 0. Optional; no client default.

max_rank_group.description: Worst search position included when measuring competitor overlap, where 1 means first. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 1. Maximum: 100. Default: 20.

min_intersections.description: Minimum count of shared ranking keywords required for a search competitor. Type: Safe integer. Minimum: 0. Maximum: 10000000. Default: 0.

sort_by.description: Metric used to order returned results; choose one of this tool’s accepted enum values. Type: String. Accepted values: "overlap", "competitor_traffic", "traffic_gap", "threat". Default: "threat".

sync.description: Request a bounded wait for completion when true. The API can still return a pending job; retain its job ID and poll agentseo_job_status instead of repeating this charged call. False returns a queued job without waiting. Type: Boolean. Default: true.

target.description: Target domain, subdomain or absolute page URL to analyze; use a hostname or URL, not a business name. Type: String. Minimum: 1 characters. Required.

name: agentseo_domain_competitors
title: AgentSEO Domain Competitors
